model.name: profile.removeLocalIdentity
model.description: Red 'Remove current ID data' button on ProfileEditor (secret-code page). Danger warning: irreversible — identity/keypair/secret lost permanently, owned rooms/files inaccessible, no undo. Confirm step (type 'DELETE' or re-enter secret code). Wipes 12 localStorage keys (rawbin-player-id, rawbin-device-id, rawbin-device-privateKey, rawbin-device-publicKey, rawbin-device-signature, rawbin-name, rawbin-avatar, rawbin-version, rawbin-editor-layout, rawbin-editor-mode, rawbin-file-tree, rawbin-trace-expanded). Post-wipe: close WS, reload → fresh enrollment flow (new UUID, profile gate).
